title: A design-system slot contract offers Apply only for the template releases checked to wear it: a release newer than its maxVersion is refused as TEMPLATE_VERSION_UNCHECKED, on WordPress in the write's own run too
steps: S2: read every packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/*.json through apps/tracy-web/src/lib/ds-slot.js slotContracts(); for each ready contract and each minVersion key, read maxVersion.

S3: contractFor(<template>, {key, version}) for joomla/ja-spa at 1.0.1; for joomla/ja-spa, emdash/tracy-business and wordpress/wp-ja-vega at their contract's maxVersion and at the next patch release past it (when written: 1.0.4/1.0.5, 1.7.14/1.7.15, 1.1.15/1.1.16; develop has since checked 1.0.5, 1.7.16, 1.1.16); maxVersionOf('wordpress/tracy-base').
S4: apps/tracy-host/src/ds-slot.js WORDPRESS_DS_PHP and validateDsSlotBody with payload.maxTheme {'wp-ja-kinetic': 'x'} and {'wp-ja-kinetic': '1.1.12'}.

S5: every translated tracy-design-inspiration.json (vi, de, es, fr, it, nl, zh) no longer has ds.unsupported.TEMPLATE_VERSION_UNCHECKED or ds.version.upTo (the tab stopped saying version reasons, 12/10/2026).
expect: S1: every test passes, none skipped.

S2: every ready contract has a string maxVersion >= minVersion for each non-null minVersion key; ja-spa, ja-morgan at 1.0.4 or later, ja-voyara 1.0.6 or later, tracy-business/emdash-0.x 1.7.14 or later, wp-ja-essence 1.0.16 or later, wp-ja-vega 1.1.15 or later (a window only moves forward).

S3: ja-spa 1.0.1 TEMPLATE_NEEDS_UPDATE need 1.0.2; each of ja-spa, tracy-business and vega at its maxVersion returns its contract, and one patch past it {reason:'TEMPLATE_VERSION_UNCHECKED', upTo:<maxVersion>, have:<next>}; maxVersionOf tracy-base names exactly tracy-base and tracy, each 1.1.5 or later.
S4: the PHP contains version_compare($tv,$top,">"); 'x' → 'refused maxTheme'; '1.1.12' → null (valid).
evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-minversion-audit-2026-10-11/README.md: every live release newer than a contract's minVersion downloaded and its stylesheets counted against the minVersion build (none lost the slot; wp-ja-vega 1.1.14's one literal pair is deliberate).
fence: the version window [minVersion, maxVersion] the door and the WordPress write enforce; not whether a given release is tokenized (that is the audit)
